thread:
Alex Chen: Kicking off a co‑hosted pilot with NorthStar (Snowflake + Databricks + Qdrant). Goal: validate a connector flow that runs in partner infra with optional Redwood inferencing — 6 weeks. Need to align tech owners, infra, and GTM. High level: private networking, shared test data, telemetry contract, and a staged announcement. Who can own what?
Maya Patel: I can take infra ops. Need clarity on networking: private link vs VPC peering? Also want a list of sample datasets and size constraints.
Leo Vargas: I can own the connector shim and vector adapter. Are we doing an agent-side embed or server-side?
Jessie Wu: I'll take GTM/partner comms. Timeline constraints: product review by week 4, co-announcement earliest week 7.
Samira Gomez: Legal/compliance: need data residency and TOS for partner-managed billing. Also contract for telemetry sharing.
Alex Chen: Thanks. Quick answers: 1) Networking: prefer PrivateLink for AWS partners, else VPC peering where PrivateLink not available. 2) Embedding: start with server-side (Redwood embeddings) to simplify metrics, plan agent-side later. 3) Sample dataset: 5–10 documents per tenant, plus a ~1GB synthetic dataset for perf.
Leo Vargas: Implementation note: connector flow = Snowflake extract -> parquet -> Databricks transform -> vector ingestion into Qdrant. We'll build a lightweight adaptor with a shim that keys off a manifest file. Example manifest snippet:```
name: northstar-pilot
sources:
  - type: snowflake
    query: "select id, text from demo.public.documents limit 10000"
  - type: databricks
    transform: "delta_share_cleaning.py"
vector_config:
  model: "open-embed-1"
  dims: 1536
  batch_size: 512
```
Leo Vargas: I'll open an RFC branch with the shim prototype by EOD Friday.
Maya Patel: Ops checklist: 1) Set up PrivateLink endpoints (partner) 2) Shared monitoring workspace (read-only) 3) Cost-visibility dashboard for partner billing 4) Network ingress/egress cap. Who will run the cost dashboard?
Jessie Wu: Marketing asks: customer-facing announcement requires joint logo approval, embargo date, and a quoted performance metric. Can we commit to a 95th percentile latency target for the demo?
Alex Chen: For demo SLOs, aim for p95 < 200ms for simple retrievals during the pilot. Success criteria for pilot: a) end-to-end connector ingest of 1M docs (synthetic) b) retrieval p95 < 200ms c) embeddings recall@10 > 0.85 on our eval set d) telemetry contract delivered.
Samira Gomez: I'll draft the telemetry DPA addendum and a simple dataflow diagram for sign-off.
Marketplace Bot: New integration checklist created: https://internal.redwood/integrations/boards/245. Items assigned to: Maya (infra), Leo (connector), Jessie (GTM), Samira (legal), Alex (PM). :white_check_mark:
Maya Patel: Ops question: who sets the rollout policy for failover? If partner infra becomes slow, do we failover to hosted Redwood model? We need a policy in the runbook.
Alex Chen: Yes — default is automatic fallback to Redwood-hosted model in region with rate-limited capacity. We'll include a canary step in week 3 to test fallback.
Leo Vargas: Dev note: we need a telemetry contract with event names and schemas. Proposing: ingest.start, ingest.chunk_upload, ingest.success, embed.request_ms, query.latency_ms, query.score. Will post a proto RFC.
Jessie Wu: For GTM, I want a two-phase announcement: 1) pilot kickoff internal comms week 0, 2) joint case study/preview to a small set of customers after pilot success, then broader announcement. Need legal sign-off on logos before week 6.
Samira Gomez: A heads-up: partner requires a minimal security questionnaire (ISO/SOC). I'll coordinate with their security SME.
Alex Chen: Action items summary (quick):
- Maya: infra & PrivateLink setup + cost dashboard (due wk1)
- Leo: connector shim + telemetry RFC (proto posted wk1)
- Jessie: GTM runbook + logo/embargo sync (wk2)
- Samira: DPA addendum + security questionnaire (wk2)
- Alex: pilot plan + success metrics + weekly syncs (owns coordination)
Maya Patel: I'll kick off the AWS PrivateLink request today — will ping when VPC endpoints ready.
Leo Vargas: RFC branch opened: git.internal/redwood/connectors/northstar-pilot — review welcome.
Jessie Wu: I'll draft the joint messaging + embargo calendar and share with legal/partner by Tuesday.
Samira Gomez: Sharing the initial DPA draft and a short checklist for SOC items by EOD Monday.
Alex Chen: Great. Weekly sync Friday 10am PT. If anyone hits a blocker earlier, ping this thread and we'll triage. :rocket:
